Fender Custom Shop Collection Workshop About Us Our Team Our Customers Contact Us Sei Bass John Giblin Collection Collectors' Corner Home » Pedals » Jam Pedals Red Muck Bass Jam Pedals Red Muck Bass SOLD Tweet Product Details The Red Muck puts on a few pounds, grows a new set of sharp teeth and is out to seduce even the most demanding Muff connoisseurs! A Fuzz-Distortion pedal, inspired from the circuits of the ’71 “triangle” and the later “Red Army / Civil War” Muff. Along with our individual touch, the end result boasts a smoother sound, fatter low end, pronounced midrange and added tonal flexibility through the expanded range of the tone knob. The onboard MIX control allows you to discover your sweet- spot of the Dry / Wet signal ratio, while the second footswitch turns it into a 2-gain-stage pedal! This pedal is equally capable at fuzzing things up just a bit to add some vintage wooly fatness to your bass lines, as it is at shooting those heavy riffs into sizzling yet controlled mayhem! T Add to cart SKU: QE3106V3 Category: Accessories Description Additional information Reviews Introduction JAM Red Muck Bass Fuzz/Distortion JAM Red Muck Fuzz: Seductive and Powerful Fuzz for Bass The JAM Red Muck Bass Fuzz/Distortion pedal has put on a few pounds, grown a new set of sharp teeth, and is out to seduce even the most demanding Muff connoisseurs! This fuzz-distortion pedal, inspired by the circuits of the ’71 triangle and the later Red Army/Civil War Muff, features JAM’s individual touch, resulting in a smoother sound, fatter low end, pronounced midrange, and added tonal flexibility. Enhanced Features for Bass Players The Red Muck boasts an expanded range of the tone knob, allowing you to dial in a wide variety of tones. The onboard MIX control lets you discover the perfect dry/wet signal ratio for your sound. Additionally, the second footswitch transforms the pedal into a 2-gain-stage monster, offering even more versatility. Versatile Sound Shaping Whether you’re looking to add some vintage woolly fatness to your bass lines or create heavy, sizzling riffs, the Red Muck is capable of delivering controlled mayhem. This pedal provides the perfect balance of fuzz and distortion, making it a valuable addition to any bassist’s setup. Specifications: Type : Bass Fuzz/Distortion Controls : Volume: Adjusts the output level. Tone: Shapes the EQ, offering a range of tones. Fuzz: Controls the amount of fuzz. MIX: Adjusts the dry/wet signal ratio. Second Footswitch: Activates a 2-gain-stage mode for additional distortion. Features : Smooth sound with a fatter low end and pronounced midrange. Expanded tonal flexibility with the tone knob. Suitable for both subtle vintage fuzz and heavy, controlled distortion. Durable construction for reliable performance.
